name: Parametric Power Adapter via Battery Contacts

captions.detailed: A rectangular, frame-like physical adapter designed to hold a flat battery. It features a hollow center to accommodate the battery body, surrounded by thin, sturdy walls. One of the shorter inner walls includes two small, recessed circular contact holes for pin terminals, while the outer walls have small, circular wire routing holes.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric battery power supply frame in OpenSCAD. The model should have adjustable dimensions for the battery length, width, and thickness, and include custom placement for two contact pins on one of the inner walls, along with wire guide holes.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a boolean difference operation. A outer solid cube is hollowed out by subtracting a smaller concentric inner cube. From this frame, wire harness holes are subtracted using rotated cylinders, and the battery interface connection is carved out using a custom module containing two Pin sub-modules (cylinders representing nail heads and shafts) and a hulled 'elbow room' module for solder clearance.
